content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Guides gumroad

When comparing options for selling digital products, it's essential to look beyond the surface level. Gumroad, for example, offers a user-friendly interface and straightforward payment processing, but its restrictions on certain countries make it inaccessible to many creators. On the other hand, sovereign commerce infrastructure providers like COREMERCH offer a more comprehensive solution, including automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad's payout delays, Payhip's withdrawal restrictions, and Lemon Squeezy's geographic unavailability all stem from the same root cause: these platforms operate within the traditional financial system. They process payments through Stripe or PayPal on the backend, which means they inherit every restriction those processors impose. When Stripe does not support your country, Gumroad cannot pay you out — regardless of what the platform's feature list implies. Paddle operates as a merchant of record, which creates additional compliance requirements that make it functionally unavailable in most of Africa, South Asia, and Latin America. These are not platform-level problems. They are financial system problems that only infrastructure built outside that system can solve.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

NOWPayments operates as a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT on multiple chains, Solana, BNB on Binance Smart Chain, and Tron. When a buyer initiates payment, NOWPayments creates a unique payment address for that specific transaction, monitors the blockchain in real time, and fires a webhook when payment confirms on-chain. The 0.5% fee is the only cost — no monthly fee, no setup fee, no revenue share, no payout schedule. Funds go directly to the wallet addresses you configure. COREMERCH never touches your wallet or your funds at any point before, during, or after deployment.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you full ownership and control over your sales and delivery processes.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the key benefits of sovereign commerce infrastructure is the level of ownership and control it provides. With traditional platforms, creators often have to rely on the platform's automated systems, which can be inflexible and prone to errors. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure allows creators to automate their sales and delivery processes using tools like Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script, giving them more control and flexibility.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Ultimately, the choice of architecture will depend on your specific situation and needs. If you're a creator in a restricted country, sovereign commerce infrastructure may be the best option. If you're looking for a more comprehensive solution that includes automatic crypto payment processing and instant product delivery, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) may be the way to go. This stack includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, and is deployed in 48 hours with 30-day support.

This involves deploying a custom commerce stack that includes automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. With the right architecture, you can bypass traditional platform restrictions and take control of your sales and delivery processes.

To deploy your own sovereign commerce infrastructure, start by setting up your GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages hosting. Next, configure your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script backend logic, and connect your Supabase or Google Sheets order storage. Then, set up your Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 file delivery, and integrate your NOWPayments crypto payment processing. Finally, test your stack end-to-end and deploy it to production, with 30-day support to help you get started.
